desc: Hi-Point produces affordable, American-made firearms featuring 100% American parts and assembly. Each handgun has a high-impact polymer frame with high-impact grips with a durable, attractive easy-grip finish which assures a firm, comfortable grip and exceptional recoil control. It has a quick on/off thumb safety, magazine disconnect safety and last round lock open feature. It has 3-dot sights with a fully-adjustable rear and an additional rear peep sight. Hi-Point handguns are +P rated and accept all factory ammunition. Each comes with a free trigger lock. This standard model 45 ACP has a 4.5" barrel for an OAL of 7.75" and weight of 35 oz. It has a black frame with black grips and a black powder coated slide. It includes an 9-round magazine. The Home Security Package combines the 45 ACP pistol with a strong and secure lock box. Constructed of heavy-duty overlap pry-resistant, 18-gauge powder coated steel, the lock box measures 11.5" x 8.5" x 1.5" and is fitted with a half-inch memory foam liner. It includes a cable and matched number keys.
